There are only three words that describe my unconditional, infinite love for you:

Shiv Shakti.
Ram Siya Ji.
Radha Krishna Ji.
If you weren't in my life, Bubuu... honestly, I would have given up on everything by now.🤗

You're not just my girlfriend or my best friend. You're my belief, Bubuu.🧿
You're the reason it's so hard for me to give up.😘😘

I love you so much that it becomes even harder for me to imagine a future without you.
I know I trouble you and irritate you sometimes, but that's another way of loving you.

And honestly, I love it so much when you scold me. 😂

Many times, I intentionally do silly things just so I can hear you scold me.

And the joy of making you angry by not listening to what you say... aaahhhhhhhhh!!!!!

And when you say, "From today onwards, I won't say anything anymore," even then I can see the love hidden behind those words... waaaaaahhhhhhhh. 😚
Because you're in my life, there's fun in it. I am happy. 😄 I am happy because I know you love me. 😘

The world's most beautiful, caring, and wonderful girl is in love with me.

Honestly, there's nothing more left for me to ask for, but even then, if I ever have to ask for something... I'll ask for you.
Every car trip I take, every time I sleep, every time I wake up, every time I take a bath, every time I do my prayers—every single activity in my life has either you or your memories in it.

And when I think about the future in all of those moments... it's you there too.
And I swear, I don't know what words could possibly be better to describe love when it feels like there aren't any words left anymore.

Remember, my biggest failure is seeing you sad or worried. And the greatest achievement of my day is making you feel every single day, how deeply I love you and making you smile.
I know your Didi, Aunty, Uncle, Bhaiya, Rocky, and Jiji all love you so much. But do you know? Even there, I end up feeling that I hope no one loves you more than I do.

I know there are billions of people... but they are not you.
I only want you.
Nothing else matters besides that.
I've never had a fake laugh with you.
Fulfilling every single wish of yours is in my own wishlist.
No matter how angry, sad, or annoyed I become, I'll always love you. 😚
